article.title: Reference Shelf 2027 Books: 8 Titles from 3000 Studios Press (2026 Guide)
article.author: Jeremy Swain
article.summary: Every reference shelf 2027 title from 3000 Studios Press in one place: 8 original books by Jeremy Swain, $9.99 each as EPUB and PDF.
article.leadParagraph: Looking for reference shelf 2027 books? 3000 Studios Press publishes 8 original reference shelf 2027 titles written by Jeremy Swain. Almanac, atlas, dictionary and study references. This guide lists every one, explains what each shelf offers, and shows exactly where to buy them.

sections.heading: The full Reference Shelf 2027 shelf
body: The shelf includes “Almanac 2027”, “The Emergency Handbook”, “Atlas 2027”, “Math 2027”, “Science 2027” and “History 2027”.

sections.heading: Price and formats
body: Every title on the shelf is $9.99. Each purchase includes both EPUB and PDF, delivered at checkout from the studio store on Payhip, so the same book works on an e-reader, a tablet, a phone or a printer.
Print editions of the wider 3000 Studios Press catalog are distributed through IngramSpark, which means bookstores and libraries can order copies through their usual channels.

sections.heading: Where to buy
body: Open the Books page at https://3000studios.vip/books and tap any cover to go straight to that title's checkout. The Reference Shelf 2027 filter on that page shows only this shelf.
New releases and chapter previews land first in the free 3000 Studios Substack newsletter.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
body: How many reference shelf 2027 books does 3000 Studios Press publish? 8, all listed above.
Who writes them? Every title is written by Jeremy Swain and published under the 3000 Studios Press imprint.
What do I get? A $9.99 purchase includes the EPUB and the PDF of the book.
